company.description:
Epizyme is a biopharmaceutical company located in Cambridge, MA, that is focused on researching treatments for blood cancer and tumors.

 Founded in late 2007, the company has brought together premier academic and industry leaders to rapidly translate the exciting discoveries emerging from epigenetic research into specific programs that will produce important, novel, molecularly targeted drugs of the future.

aiResearchSummary.text: Epizyme is researching and developing methods and compositions for treating cancer, including blood cancers and tumors, by targeting histone methyltransferases such as EZH2 and EHMT2. Titles like 'Method for treating cancer,' 'Combination therapy for treating cancer,' and 'EZH2 inhibitors for treating lymphoma' describe approaches using EZH2 inhibitors, combination therapies with other agents, and treatment of specific cancers such as mantle cell lymphoma and medulloblastoma. These efforts focus on epigenetic modulation and targeted cancer therapies.
